rationale.award_size: Money is the point; normalized to runway so a $10k grant at Series A scores low.
rationale.eligibility_fit: A perfect grant you can't apply for is worthless; hard eligibility gates.
rationale.effort_inverse: Applications take real time; a $5k grant needing 40 hours is a bad trade.
rationale.strategic_value: Intros, press, and city relationships that outlast the cash.
rationale.deadline_urgency: Grant windows are fixed and non-negotiable; miss it and wait a year.
